title: Unhinged Woman Sparks Neighborhood Uproar After Attacking Kids
description:
On March 29th, 2024. A caller reported that there was mass commotion on the street involving two neighbours. Upon investigation, they found out that kids were just playing around in the neighbourhood when a woman got agitated because some of the children started stepping into her lawn, the woman then started being rude and nasty to the kids, even going as far as to push and knock down some of the children. The kids ranged from the ages of 5-14 years old, while the woman was 44 years of age.

Disclaimer: 

The videos on Police Watch are intended solely for informative and educational purposes. They are not meant to encourage or promote any illegal activities or unsafe behavior.  Body-worn camera footage has been edited for length and in accordance with YouTube community guidelines while maintaining a journalistic focus. The content is designed to provide insight into law enforcement procedures, police interactions, and public safety awareness. Always respect the law and follow local regulations.
